headlines.title: Forget Ford's Lucrative Dividend. GM Has a Different and Perhaps Better Way to Reward Investors.
headlines.summary: While Ford is often praised for its lucrative dividend yield and additional "special dividends," General Motors actually has a total yield that is roughly double Ford's.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Unveiled A $20b Buyback, Is The Stock Still A Bargain?
headlines.summary: General Motors (GM) just paired a strong third quarter earnings report with a fresh US$20b share repurchase program, while also flagging higher costs that could pressure margins into 2027 and temper investor enthusiasm. That backdrop helps explain why General Motors shares have retreated in the short term, with the 7 day share price return down 9.6% and the 30 day move down 9.4%.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Is Expanding Its Hybrid Lineup
headlines.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) is accelerating a new wave of U.S. hybrid models as gasoline prices stay elevated in late 2026. Management is reviving and expanding hybrid powertrains across key segments to address shifting domestic buyer demand away from pure combustion. Super Cruise is recording strong year over year gains in revenue and paid users as more GM vehicles ship with the software enabled.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
